"""Allowlisted browser-only environment; importing this module makes no external call."""
from pathlib import Path
import json
import os

runtime = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo = runtime.parents[1] / 'worktrees/creative-engine'
package = Path('/opt/homebrew/Cellar/oracle/0.22.2/libexec/lib/node_modules/@steipete/oracle')
helper = repo / 'tools/oracle'
node = Path('/opt/homebrew/bin/node').resolve()
pins = json.loads((helper / 'upstream-pins.json').read_text())
files = ([helper / n for n in ['entry.mjs', 'register.mjs', 'patch.mjs', 'image-dom.mjs', 'upstream-pins.json']]
         + [package / n for n in pins['files']]
         + [package / 'dist/src/mcp/tools/chatgptImage.js', node, runtime / 'oracle-home/config.json']
         + [runtime / n for n in ['environment.py', 'prepare.mts', 'diagnose.mts', 'execute.py', 'runtime.mts']])
env = {
    'PATH': os.environ['PATH'], 'HOME': str(runtime), 'NO_PROXY': '*', 'no_proxy': '*',
    'NO_COLOR': '1', 'ORACLE_ENABLED': 'true', 'ORACLE_HOME_DIR': str(runtime / 'oracle-home'),
    'ORACLE_BROWSER_PROFILE_DIR': '/Users/a/.oracle/browser-profile',
    'ORACLE_MCP_COMMAND': str(node),
    'ORACLE_MCP_ARGS': json.dumps([str(helper / 'entry.mjs'), '--package-root', str(package), '--mcp']),
    'ORACLE_RUNTIME_FILES': json.dumps([str(p) for p in files]),
    'CREATIVE_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT_MS': '600000', 'OPENAI_AGENTS_DISABLE_TRACING': '1',
}
assert not any('KEY' in k or 'TOKEN' in k for k in env)

execute.py.contents:
"""Explicit modes: prepare is local-only; execute-once is external and is NOT run by preparation."""
from environment import runtime, repo, env
import hashlib
import json
import os
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time

if len(sys.argv) != 2 or sys.argv[1] not in ('prepare', 'execute-once'):
    raise SystemExit('Usage: python3 execute.py prepare|execute-once')
stage = sys.argv[1]
base = [str(repo / 'node_modules/.bin/tsx')]
if stage == 'prepare':
    home = runtime / 'oracle-home'
    home.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=True)
    config = home / 'config.json'
    if config.exists():
        raise SystemExit('Already prepared/config exists; do not overwrite pins')
    config.write_text(json.dumps({'engine': 'browser', 'browser': {
        'manualLogin': True, 'manualLoginProfileDir': '/Users/a/.oracle/browser-profile',
        'manualLoginCookieSync': False, 'cookieSync': False, 'modelStrategy': 'current',
        'archiveConversations': 'never', 'keepBrowser': True, 'captureProviderNative': False,
        'timeoutMs': 540000, 'inputTimeoutMs': 45000}}, indent=2) + '\n')
    config.chmod(0o600)
    proc = subprocess.run(base + [str(runtime / 'prepare.mts'), str(runtime)], cwd=repo,
                          env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
    (runtime / 'prepare.log').write_text(proc.stdout + proc.stderr)
    print(proc.stdout, end='')
    if proc.returncode:
        print(proc.stderr, file=sys.stderr)
    raise SystemExit(proc.returncode)

target = json.loads((runtime / 'target.json').read_text())
env.update({'ALLOW_TEST_LIVE': 'on', 'CREATIVE_ENGINE_P7_ROOT': target['operator'],
            'CREATIVE_ENGINE_P7_APPROVED_GRANT_SHA256': target['pin']})
if (runtime / 'execution-started.json').exists() or (runtime / 'diagnostic-result.json').exists():
    raise SystemExit('Existing invocation: reconcile; automatic replay prohibited')
with (runtime / 'execution-started.json').open('x') as marker:
    json.dump({'state': 'started', 'started_at_unix': time.time(), 'reservation_usd': .25,
               'api_requests_added': 0, 'retry_allowed': False}, marker)
cmd = base + [str(runtime / 'diagnose.mts'), str(runtime), '--execute-once']
out = runtime / 'execute-once.log'
started = time.monotonic()
timed_out = False
with out.open('xb') as log:
    proc = subprocess.Popen(cmd, cwd=repo, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                            start_new_session=True)
    try:
        code = proc.wait(timeout=650)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        timed_out = True
        os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        try:
            proc.wait(timeout=5)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            proc.wait()
        code = 124
    finally:
        revoked = runtime / 'operator/revoked'
        if not revoked.exists():
            with revoked.open('x') as marker:
                marker.write('Wrapper closed one-shot diagnostic. Timeout/failure may leave external state unknown; no retry.\n')
            revoked.chmod(0o600)
result = {'command': cmd, 'exit_code': code, 'source_sha': target['source_sha'],
          'duration_seconds': time.monotonic() - started, 'timed_out': timed_out,
          'log_sha256': hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
          'api_credentials_inherited': False, 'api_requests_added': 0, 'api_cost_usd': 0,
          'actual_subscription_cost_usd': None, 'subscription_cost': 'unmetered',
          'diagnostic_only': True, 'native_worker_success': False, 'human_approval': False,
          'retry_allowed': False}
(runtime / 'execute-once-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(result))
raise SystemExit(code)
